lines.en: My steps sound heavy through the leaves.
Four paws down, and the ground shudders.
I walk along the roots the whole way.
In the jungle I take my time.
My shoulder brushes the underbrush.
Left paw up, then the right.
I steer around my own old tracks.
In the winter woods there's only me.
Birds scatter where I walk.
I walk this slope every day.
Nose to the ground, I sniff as I go.
The woods are thick; I squeeze through.
I just sit by the stump.
Don't mind me; I'm only dazing.
A sniff of air, nothing else.
Two scrapes of the paw in the dirt.
I'm waiting for full dark.
Leaning on a trunk is comfortable enough.
I'd rather not move just now.
I listen to the wood's small noises.

lines.zh: 你是谁，为什么在我林子
lines.en: Who are you, and why in my woods?
I smell something sweet on you.
That thing in your hand glints.
Don't move suddenly; I might misread it.
I stand two heads above you.
Back up three steps, then we talk.
I don't dislike you, but we're strangers.
This wood is mine to patrol.
You've left your pack showing.
Would you dare touch my tree?
One look up and I've sized you.
Want past? You back off first.
You dare raise a hand to me.
That genuinely hurt.
I was knocked back two steps.
You've picked the wrong fight.
You cut my shoulder.
Blood shows under the fur.
I need a breath.
It hurts, but I won't run.
I'll remember your face.

lines.zh: 别以为我站不稳就好欺负
lines.en: Don't think unsteady means weak.
Sweet. Honeycomb, isn't it?
I know that smell.
Don't put it away; I didn't say no.
Eat this and I belong to you?
Just one small lick to taste.
Why is your hand trembling?
Sweeter than any fruit up the tree.
I'll walk over slowly; don't run.
Give it, and I won't swat you.
The bump pushed me back a step.
You're too light; I barely felt it.
Mind these shoulders of mine.
Move; I can't get through.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是我，不是我撞你
lines.en: You hit me, not the other way.

lines.zh: 这一下把我毛都撞乱了
lines.en: That ruffled my fur.
I'm steady; are you all right?
The path is only this wide.
Once more and I won't be polite.
Let's both step back and drop it.
Your pawprint is smaller than mine.
Let's build a den and winter together.
Don't bite my ear.
This tree is big enough for us both.
You smell like earth after rain.
We'll take turns at the den mouth.
Go slow; I'm clumsy.
Winter's here; stay close.

lines.zh: 有你在，林子里不那么空
lines.en: With you the woods feel less empty.
You think you can carry me?
Don't grab this fur of mine.
I'm heavy; pace yourself.
Put me down; I can walk.
Your hands are pinned under me.
Held like this is uncomfortable.
I can smell the sweat on your palms.
I'll allow this only once.
Where are you taking me?
I know the way back to the woods.
You're too close to my tree.
I warned you once.
Stop right there.
You trampled the edge of my den.
Now I'm genuinely angry.
You're not welcome in this wood.
I'll drive you out.
You can't outrun my four legs.
These paws can snap branches.
That last step was a mistake.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢大喊，我喜欢动手
lines.en: I don't shout; I act.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道我不喜欢了
lines.en: I no longer like your scent.
Too late to retreat now.
Standing, I'm taller than the stump.

lines.zh: 让你见识一下熊的分量
lines.en: Let me show you a bear's weight.
I stay behind you.
Do you hear my breathing?
You walk one, I take two.
This wood has no side paths.
No rush; I'll wait for you to hit a tree.
That black shape in the shade is me.
Look back, and there I am.
Your footsteps have lost rhythm.
I can smell your sweat.
Run more and you'll drop that pack.
I know every gully better than you.
Count how many trees remain.
I keep my steps quiet.
The moment you stop, I'm on you.
My patience outlasts your hope.
You're panting harder than I am.
Past this slope is a dead end.
No growl, no roar.
One paw comes down.
This claw has weight.
You can't block this one.
I go for your shoulder.
Now you know a bear's strength.
This one sends you flying.
And here's another.
Don't get up; save your strength.
Hiding by the tree won't help.

lines.zh: 我的咬合比你想象的重
lines.en: My bite is heavier than you think.
If you're hit, don't just stand there.
I'm slow, but one blow is enough.
I took bark off with that swing.

lines.zh: 你身上的气味越来越近
lines.en: Your scent is getting closer.
That was your lesson.
Again; I'm not done.
I step out from behind the tree.
This wood has an owner now.
I sniffed the wind first.
My paw snapped a dead branch.
This winter will be long.
I'm not fully awake yet.
Every bird in the tree has fled.
Who lit a fire on my ground?

lines.zh: 我站起来，比灌木高得多
lines.en: Standing, I tower over the brush.

lines.zh: 林子安静下来，是因为我
lines.en: The wood goes quiet because of me.

lines.zh: 这儿的果子今年结得少
lines.en: Fewer fruit this year.
I'm here; I'll walk my own way.
The flames curled my fur.
That fall rattled my bones.
Water poured into my nose.
The blast slammed me into a tree.

lines.zh: 那支箭扎进我厚厚的皮
lines.en: That arrow sank into my thick hide.
The spell made my head swim.
Hunger keeps me from standing.

lines.zh: 雷劈在树上，也劈到了我
lines.en: The bolt split the tree and caught me too.
The black beneath drags me down.
